1007.description: A standing twisting crunch with a band, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper back, crossing it in front of your chest.
Hold the ends of the band with your hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and twist your torso to one side, bringing your elbow towards the opposite knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在上背部，穿过胸前。
用手握住带子的末端，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌并将躯干向一侧扭转，将肘部移向另一侧的膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1071.description: Row yourself up under straps with knees bent. It builds the back.
instructions: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

1135.description: A forearm plank with feet in the straps and one leg raised, fighting rotation and sag.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.

1199.description: A wide-stance deadlift finished with an upright row. It works the thighs, glutes and shoulders in one smooth motion.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

1263.description: A one-arm cable fly seated on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and core.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a cable handle in one hand and extend your arm out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and your palm facing forward.
Slowly bring your arm across your body, squeezing your chest muscles.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住电缆手柄，并将手臂向一侧伸出，与地面平行。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌朝前。
慢慢地将手臂放在身体上，挤压胸部肌肉。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1327.description: A chin-up with your hands close together on an underhand grip. It works the lats and puts extra load on the biceps.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 抓住引体向上杆，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1391.description: A calf press done on a leg press sled using only your toes. It builds the calves under a supported load.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the sled, with your toes pointing forward.
Release the safety handles and push the sled away from you by extending your knees and ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the sled back down by bending your knees and ankles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整压腿机的座椅，使双脚踩在雪橇上时膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双脚与肩同宽放在雪橇上，脚趾指向前方。
松开安全手柄，并通过伸展膝盖和脚踝将雪橇推离您。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后弯曲膝盖和脚踝，慢慢将雪橇放回原处。
重复所需的重复次数。

1455.description: A machine chest press with a lever arm that guides the push. It builds the chest and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit back with your shoulder blades against the pad and feet flat.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause, then return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back on the pad throughout.

1519.description: A good morning on the Smith machine starting from the pins. It builds the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Set the bar on the pins at upper-chest height and duck under it.
Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is near parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.

1583.description: A hack squat done facing the pad on the sled. It puts more load on the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Face the pad of the hack squat sled with your chest against it and feet on the platform.
Hold the handles and release the safety.
Lower by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest pressed against the pad.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

1647.description: Alternating dumbbell curls on a preacher bench. It builds the biceps with no momentum.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on the pad of the preacher bench, allowing your arms to fully extend.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell in your right hand as you contract your biceps.
Continue to curl the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师凳的垫子上，让手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯曲右手的哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续弯举哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1711.description: A partner-assisted stretch for the outer hip and side of the trunk. It eases tightness in the small gluteal muscles and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back or side while your partner supports your top leg.
Have your partner gently guide the leg across your body while you stay relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1775.description: A side plank with a top leg raise. Challenges the inner and outer thighs while keeping the core braced.
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将上面的腿抬向天花板，保持笔直。
慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1839.description: Tilts the head back to stretch the muscles at the front of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return your head to neutral.

1903.description: Brings the leg forward and out to open the outer hip.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1967.description: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole inward.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2095.description: A stretch that bends the fingers back to lengthen the palm side of the forearm.
instructions: Extend one arm in front with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
Gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and the wrist relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2159.description: A single-leg glute bridge with a band added, making your glutes and hamstrings work harder on each side.
instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor and extend that leg.
Drive through the other heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and keep the hips level.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2287.description: A machine leg press done one leg at a time, alternating. Builds the quads and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the seat and foot platform of the leverage machine to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the foot platform.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push one foot against the foot platform, extending your leg until it is almost fully straight.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your leg and return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅和脚踏平台调整到您想要的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将手放在机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
将一只脚推到脚平台上，伸展腿直到几乎完全伸直。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲腿，回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2351.description: A side-by-side form check for the bottom position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows angled back, and hips stay in line.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2415.description: A lateral raise done while leaning away from a support for a greater range on the side delt.
instructions: Hold a support with one hand and lean your body away.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand by your side.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

2671.description: A bent-over row on the smith machine with a narrow grip, working the lats and mid back.
instructions: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension.

2735.description: Carrying a heavy yoke frame across your upper back and walking with it. Strengthens the legs, trunk and traps.
instructions: Step under the yoke so it rests across your upper back and grip the frame.
Brace your core and stand up to lift it off the supports.
Walk forward in quick, controlled steps, keeping your torso upright.
At the end, lower the yoke back onto the supports with care.

2799.description: A seated alternate leg raise holding a barbell across the thighs. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping the other leg on the ground.
Lower the raised leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，将杠铃放在大腿上。
保持双腿伸直，将一条腿尽可能高地抬起，同时将另一条腿放在地上。
将抬起的腿放回原位，然后换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2863.description: A bridge that lifts the hips and adds a leg raise, working the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.

2927.description: Pressing a kettlebell held upside down from a kneeling position. The unstable load demands shoulder control and grip.
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold a kettlebell bottoms up at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and keep your wrist straight.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulder, keeping the bell balanced.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2991.description: A seated shoulder control drill on a ball with one leg lifted. It challenges balance while you raise, lower and pull back the shoulder blades.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet on the floor.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and hold your balance.
Raise your arms forward, then press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together without arching your back.
Return slowly to the start and complete your reps.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.

3119.description: A bodyweight squat done as a deep, comfortable squat. Works the legs, glutes and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低自己，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3183.description: A clean started with the bar hanging below the knees. It builds explosive hip power.
instructions: Stand with the bar hanging below your knees in an overhand grip.
Hinge back with a flat back and shoulders over the bar.
Drive your hips forward and jump explosively.
Shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control.

3311.description: A front squat started from a rack or blocks height, so you begin the rep with the bar already set. It builds quad and trunk strength.
instructions: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.

3375.description: Sweeping the ropes out and in like a fly, hitting the shoulders and upper body.
instructions: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.

3439.description: An explosive overhead throw behind you that trains the hips and posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with a medicine ball held between your legs.
Squat slightly, then explode up.
Swing the ball up and back over your head.
Release it behind you at full extension.
Retrieve the ball.
Reset your stance and repeat.

3503.description: A side plank where you crunch the top elbow toward the knee. It targets the obliques and core.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3567.description: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed over the other knee, pull the legs in to stretch the glutes and deep hip rotators.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3631.description: Sit with legs wide and lean forward to open the inner thighs and hips.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs spread wide.
Keep your back straight and toes pointing up.
Lean forward from the hips.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then return slowly.

3695.description: A dumbbell bench press where you press one arm at a time, starting with both weights held high. It challenges chest strength and stability.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press both dumbbells up above your chest.
Keep one arm locked out and lower the other dumbbell to chest level.
Press it back up to the top.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
Keep your feet planted and your back flat on the bench.

3759.description: A seated good morning on a lever machine, hinging forward at the hips and back up. It trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your hips are slightly higher than your knees.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean forward from your hips until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使臀部略高于膝盖。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
保持背部挺直，从臀部开始慢慢向前倾斜，直到上半身与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后通过推动臀肌和腿筋慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3823.description: A plank with your feet raised where you tap alternate shoulders. It trains shoulder strength and core stability.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips from rocking.

3887.description: A jump onto and over a box that builds explosive leg power and coordination.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump onto the box and land softly with bent knees.
Step or hop down on the other side.
Turn around and repeat in the other direction.
Reset your balance between reps.

3951.description: A sit-up with a twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and twist toward one knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

4015.description: A close grip dumbbell press on an incline. It targets the triceps and upper chest.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells together over your chest.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Lower to your chest.
Press up.
Keep the dumbbells touching.

4079.description: Standing band press, one arm at a time, hitting the chest and triceps.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand straight forward.
Return and press the other hand.
Keep your torso steady.

4143.description: A kickback with a band for the back of the arm.
instructions: Stand on the band and hinge forward holding the other end.
Pin your upper arm to your side.
Extend your elbow straight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

4207.description: A chin-up variation where you pull your body around the bar rather than straight over it. It challenges lats, biceps and grip.
instructions: Grab the bar with an underhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your core and pull your elbows down.
Pull your chest toward the bar, sweeping your head around one side.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control back to a full hang.
Alternate the side you pass on each rep.

4335.description: A weighted side bend using a dumbbell to load the obliques.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Place your other hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side, keeping your hips still.
Squeeze the opposite side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

4399.description: A standing back-bending pose that opens the chest and front of the hips and stretches the abdomen.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and your hands on your lower back.
Lengthen through your spine.
Lift your chest and gently arch backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your legs strong.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

4463.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the outer lower leg (peroneus muscles). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your outer lower leg (peroneus muscles) while sitting on the floor with your leg extended.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4527.description: A hip-driven swing with one hand on a kettlebell. It builds explosive posterior chain power.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the arm stay relaxed; the hips do the work.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again. Switch hands after your set.

4591.description: A straight rear-hand punch with hip rotation, thrown to a partner's pad.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the pad.
Keep your chin tucked and left hand up.
Snap back to your stance.

4719.description: A dip with a band under your knees to help with the load while building triceps and chest strength.
instructions: Loop a band across dip bars and place your knees in it.
Support yourself with straight arms.
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

4783.description: A seated pull-up with your feet raised on a bench, which increases the load. It builds the back and arms.
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and sit under a bar.
Grab it with an overhand grip, arms extended.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

4847.description: Raising a weight plate in front of you to above eye level. It trains the front shoulders and upper chest.
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the plate up and overhead.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

4911.description: An inverted row where you start with a wide grip and finish narrow. It trains the whole back and the arms.
instructions: Set a bar or straps at waist height and lie underneath.
Grab it with a wide grip and straighten your body.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Bring your hands closer on the way up or between reps.
Lower yourself with control.
Keep your body in a straight line.

4975.description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

5039.description: A low-impact burpee without the jump. It raises your heart rate while staying quiet and gentle on the joints.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step your feet back into a plank.
Step your feet forward to your hands.
Stand up tall.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

5167.description: A one-legged glute bridge with the hip turned outward. It targets the glutes and the small hip stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Press through your planted heel and raise your hips.
Turn the raised knee gently outward as you hold the top.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glutes.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

6063.description: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang fully.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

6511.description: A high cable row focused on moving your shoulder blade, building control in your upper back.
instructions: Set a cable high and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your shoulder blade back and down, bending the elbow slightly.
Squeeze at the end.
Release slowly, then switch arms.

6767.description: Lying on your side with a ball at the neck to ease the scalene muscles. Use light pressure.
instructions: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head with a pillow or your hand.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently press or nod to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

6959.description: A push-up with a band supporting the body to make the rep easier. It helps you build toward full push-ups.
instructions: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
Keep your body in a straight line.

7279.description: Squat paired with an explosive pull on the straps, linking legs and back in one move.
instructions: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up through your legs.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.

8303.description: A seated trunk twist done tall on a chair. It loosens the spine and works the obliques gently.
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Pause briefly.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips still.

8431.description: A simple seated stretch that opens up the sides of your back and shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

8879.description: From a half kneeling stance you rotate the arm outward and press the cable overhead. It trains shoulder stability along with the press.
instructions: Kneel on one knee side-on to the cable with the handle at chest height.
Hold the handle near your shoulder with your elbow bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Rotate your forearm outward, then press the handle overhead.
Return along the same path with control.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

10031.description: A small hand mobility drill where you curl your fingers while holding the thumb straight. It helps finger and thumb control.
instructions: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.

10095.description: A single-arm cable fly done in a braced, staggered stance, working the chest and keeping the trunk steady.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish reps and switch arms.

10543.description: Kneeling beside a chair for support, you gently bend the knee. It builds comfortable knee range of motion.
instructions: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.

10671.description: A seated machine press with a weight stack. It is a stable way to build the chest and triceps.
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit back and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause without locking out.
Return slowly to a gentle chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat.

10735.description: A hanging ab move where you lift one knee at a time. It strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.

10863.description: A one-arm seated press on the smith machine with a neutral grip. It trains the shoulder while the bar path stays guided.
instructions: Set a bench under the smith bar and sit upright with your back supported.
Hold the bar with one hand in a neutral grip and unhook it.
Press the bar overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower it slowly to around chin height.
Keep your torso steady. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

10927.description: A towel slid forward along a wall that presses the arm out. It builds gentle shoulder control.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.
Slide the towel forward as your arm straightens.
Slide it back slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

11055.description: A sumo deadlift on a belt squat style lever machine holding a V bar. It loads the legs and hips with less strain on the back.
instructions: Stand wide on the platform with toes angled out and grip the V bar.
Sit your hips back, chest up, and keep your arms straight.
Push through your heels to stand fully upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control, letting your knees track over your toes.

11567.description: A combo move on a lever machine: curl the legs up, then lift the hips and legs to work hamstrings and glutes together.
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pads behind your lower legs.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower with control.
Move into the reverse hyperextension position with the pad behind your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging.

0047.description: A barbell press on an incline bench, favouring the upper chest and front delts.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部呈 45 度角。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0111.description: A standing calf raise in a rocking motion, loading the calf muscles.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
将脚跟抬离地面，尽可能高，用脚掌保持平衡。
慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0175.description: Kneeling cable crunch with a rope behind the head. Crunching down against the pulley loads the abs with steady tension.
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a high pulley and kneel down facing away from the machine.
Hold the rope handle with both hands and place it behind your head, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Keeping your hips stationary, flex your waist and crunch your torso down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到高滑轮上，然后面向远离机器的方向跪下。
双手握住绳柄，将其放在脑后，肘部向两侧伸出。
保持臀部不动，弯曲腰部并将躯干向大腿方向挤压。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0239.description: A seated cable row with a straight back and an overhand grip. It builds the muscles of the mid and upper back.
instructions: Sit on the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from the hips.
Pull the cable handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在电缆划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
将电缆手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0303.description: A decline press with the palms facing each other, using dumbbells. The neutral grip is easier on the shoulders and works the chest.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸至胸部上方。
将哑铃降低到胸部两侧，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃推回到起始位置，充分伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0367.description: One forearm rests over a bench with the palm up while you curl the dumbbell with your wrist. It builds the underside of the forearm.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Rest your forearm on the bench with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝下。
将前臂放在长凳上，手腕悬在长凳边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将哑铃拉向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0431.description: Holding dumbbells, you step up onto a bench or box and step down. It builds the glutes and thighs, one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the bench or step, straightening your right leg.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench or step, standing fully upright.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 站在长凳或台阶前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在长凳或台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到长凳或台阶上，伸直右腿。
将左脚放在长凳或台阶上，完全直立。
左脚向后退一步，然后是右脚，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0495.description: On an incline, you sit up and twist toward each side. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward.
As you curl up, twist your torso to one side, bringing your elbow towards the opposite knee.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your torso to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离长凳，向前卷曲。
当你蜷缩起来时，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，将你的肘部拉向另一侧的膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将你的躯干扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0559.description: Lying on your back, you hug one knee toward your chest. It stretches the glutes and eases the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Bend one knee and clasp your hands around the shin or behind the thigh.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and switch sides.

0623.description: Lying down, you lift legs in opposite directions at the same time. It works the lower abs and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise one leg toward the ceiling while the other hovers near the floor.
Switch the legs at the same time.
Keep both legs mostly straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Move at a controlled pace.

0687.description: Seated and leaning back, you rotate your torso from side to side. Works the obliques and abs.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Hold your hands together in front of your chest or hold a weight if desired.
Lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing your hands or weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing your hands or weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
稍微向后倾斜，同时保持背部挺直并且核心参与。
如果需要，双手合拢放在胸前或举重物。
将脚抬离地面，在坐骨上保持平衡。
将你的躯干向右扭转，将你的手或重量移向身体的右侧。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将手或体重移向身体的左侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0751.description: On the smith machine, you bench press with a close grip. Puts more focus on the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
将杠铃向胸部降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0815.description: A triceps dip with the hands on a chair behind you and the body lowered toward the floor. It builds the triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your hands next to your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the front of the chair with your legs extended in front of you.
Straighten your arms, keeping a little bend in your elbows to keep tension on your triceps and off your elbow joints.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower your body toward the floor until your elbows are at about a 90-degree angle.
Once you reach the bottom of the movement, press down into the chair to straighten your elbows, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳的边缘，双手放在臀部旁边，手指指向前方。
将你的屁股从椅子前面滑下来，双腿伸到你面前。
伸直手臂，保持肘部稍微弯曲，以保持三头肌和肘关节的张力。
慢慢弯曲你的肘部，将你的身体向地板降低，直到你的肘部成大约 90 度角。
一旦到达动作的底部，向下压入椅子以伸直肘部，返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0943.description: A deeper version of chair pose where you sit lower with arms lifted. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back and down as if lowering into a chair.
Reach your arms up beside your ears and lengthen your spine.
Sink a little deeper while keeping your weight in your heels.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then straighten your legs to stand.
